units: <cite ref="Makkot 16b">Macc. 16ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>עובר משום לא תְשַׁקְּציּ</he> transgresses the law, ‘ye shall not make yourselves abominable’ (<cite ref="Leviticus 20:25">Lev. XX, 25</cite>).—Part. pass. <cite ref="M02840"><he>מְשׁוּקָּץ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 63b:9">Yeb. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>שאין לך מש׳ ומתועב וכ׳</he> for none is more detested and abhorred before the Lord than he that walks naked &c.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:9">Cant. R. to I, 9</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 106:20">Ps. CVI, 20</cite>) <he>אין לך מנוול ומש׳ וכ׳</he> nothing is so repulsive and disgusting as a grass-eating ox; a. e.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 31:1">Pesik. R. s. 31</cite> <he>והיו מִשְׁתַּקְּצוֹת וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="P00393"><he>עָזַב</he></cite>.
